laws.rule: Entrance fees for foreigners: Wadi Rum JD 5; Aqaba Castle JD 3. (No RBA rate for JOD; at the Central Bank of Jordan rate of 30 October 2026 crossed via the RBA USD rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 0.4991 JOD: JD 5 ≈ A$10.02; JD 3 ≈ A$6.01)
